quote: FY2018 10-K (Linde plc; latest print of 2016, ASU 2017-07 recast) Consolidated Statements of Income ($ in Millions; Dec. 31, 2018 | 2017 | 2016): "Other income (expenses) – net | 18 | 4 | 23" (above operating profit, operating); "Operating Profit | 5,247 | 2,444 | 2,247"; "Interest expense – net | 202 | 161 | 190"; "Net pension and OPEB cost (benefit), excluding service cost | (4) | (4) | 9"; "Income From Continuing Operations Before Income Taxes and Equity Investments | 5,049 | 2,287 | 2,048". 2,247 - 190 - 9 = 2,048.
rule_proposal: Ruling 16 (2026-11-21): the non-service pension/OPEB cost is the only non-interest line between operating profit and pretax, so other_income_expense_net = minus that line = -9,000,000 (identity: 2,048 - 2,247 + 190 = -9). Must match LIN 2017 (+4M) from the same filing. Successor registrant includes predecessor (ruling 18).
